title: Homemade High-Protein Greek Yogurt
description: Thick, strained Greek yogurt made in a rice cooker's Yogurt mode with UHT milk, skim milk powder and a starter from the previous batch. No preheating to 85°C.

ingredients.name: plain Greek yogurt
ingredients.note: From the previous batch; plain live-culture yogurt such as Đà Lạt Milk for the first batch.

steps.text: Whisk the skim milk powder into the UHT milk until completely dissolved. You do not need the old 82–85°C heating step.
Gently stir in the yogurt starter until evenly mixed.
Put the mixture in the rice cooker and run Yogurt mode for approximately 8 hours, until set.
Pour into a cloth-lined strainer over a bowl and strain in the fridge for approximately 11.5 hours. The recorded batch produced 707 g yogurt and 368 g whey.
Transfer the thick yogurt to a clean covered container and keep refrigerated. Save 40 g as starter for the next batch.

notes: Latest method: skip heating to 85°C. UHT milk is already heat-treated, and 100 g skim milk powder gives enough thickness.
Latest measured batch (23 Sep 2026): 707 g finished yogurt and 368 g strained whey after 11.5 hours.
Nutrition is approximate, estimated from full-cream UHT milk, skim milk powder and 40 g starter, less nutrients lost in about 368 g strained whey. Exact numbers depend on milk brands and final yield.
If starting without saved yogurt, use a plain live-culture yogurt starter, as in earlier batches.
